A live load of the hub, waited out 16 seconds, returns zero elements at z-index ≥ 9999, zero fixed elements covering 80% or more of the viewport, and four viewport probe points that all resolve to ordinary static content instead of a blocking div; 109 article links are clickable in the DOM. GSC MOVED THE RIGHT WAY ON EVERY LINE: clicks 31 → 32, impressions 1,039 → 1,051, average position 26.6 → 26.0 (a fourth consecutive gain) and the query table grew 78 → 80 rows. The window slid one day, 29 Aug out and 26 Sep in, which accounts for most of it.

BUT THE BRAND SHARE ROSE AGAIN: 24 of 32 clicks (75.0%, up from 74.2%) come from four navigational brand queries. The only non-brand clicked query is “i want 3 months”, 1 click on 1 impression — not commercial intent. Every commercial non-brand query is still at zero clicks, day 53.

THE TRACKED RANKING BOARD IS ALMOST COMPLETELY FROZEN: ten of the eleven tracked queries are unchanged on BOTH position and impressions. The only movement anywhere is custom living space melbourne, impressions 22 → 21. 3d renders for real estate melbourne holds the best non-brand position at 15.3; 3d rendering services melbourne is absent for a thirteenth day.

GA4 ENGAGEMENT RECOVERED FOR A SECOND WEEK. Week over week engagement rate rose 27.01% → 33.55% and average engagement time per session jumped 8s → 1m 04s, after a nine-week slide. Sessions fell 174 → 155 but events rose 677 → 774 — fewer visits, more done per visit.

OVER THE FULL 28 DAYS GA4 IS ESSENTIALLY FLAT: sessions 552 → 555, users 392 → 393, engagement rate 33.88% → 34.59%, key events 3 → 3. All three key events fall in the most recent 7 days and all three are attributed to Direct.

FACEBOOK ARRIVES UNDER FIVE SEPARATE SOURCE/MEDIUM PAIRS totalling 148 sessions — more than google/organic at 111. m.facebook.com alone sends 76 sessions at 5.26% engagement and 0s average time, the worst-quality source on the site. Organic Search remains the best: 128 sessions at 60.94% and 1m 43s.

THE SPAM BACKLINK INFLUX MORE THAN DOUBLED ITS RATE: referring domains 709 → 814 (+105, after +44) and backlinks 745 → 850 (+105) — the largest single-day increase in the series and a third consecutive acceleration. NOT ONE of the 105 new domains is followed, so the followed share fell 42.3% → 37.0%.

DR and UR remain 0 and Ahrefs Rank actually improved 185,391,207 → 182,995,001. The influx is not yet hurting measured authority, but the shape — 513 of 814 domains not followed, all new links nofollow — is a link-spam signature, not organic growth.

AI VISIBILITY BROKE A TWENTY-SCAN FREEZE AND FELL 30 → 28. The cause is single and precise: Perplexity citations fell 1 → 0, so platforms with any presence fell 3 → 2. Total AI responses (17) and cited pages (11) did NOT fall — only their spread narrowed. Copilot rose 9 → 10 responses and ChatGPT held at 7.

TECHNICAL READINESS STAYS MAXED at 7 of 7 signals: robots.txt names six AI crawlers and blocks none, llms.txt and llms-full.txt both serve, the sitemap carries 119 URLs and 95 articles, and 116 of 118 pages carry JSON-LD. The articles_render caveat is now RESOLVED because the overlay is gone.

THE SITE GOT FASTER AND THE HOMEPAGE IS NO LONGER THE SLOWEST PAGE: it fell 617 → 477 ms and the new ceiling is /articles/home-cinema-cost-australia at 581 ms. Core improved sharply 402 → 336 ms, site mean 334 → 323 ms, and all 118 pages are under one second for a sixth consecutive crawl.

THE CORPUS GREW FOR THE FIRST TIME WITHOUT A NEW ARTICLE: 239,577 → 241,329 words (+1,752) across exactly five articles, with the three shortest on the site lifted clear of 1,500 words — contemporary-houses 1,384 → 1,920, virtual-reality-in-australia 1,393 → 1,838, how-3d-configurators 1,062 → 1,504.

THE 28 SEP TEMPLATE REGRESSION HAS NOT REVERSED: total internal links moved only 2,708 → 2,711 against 2,802 before it, and the three added links come from those three expanded articles, not from the template. The featured block still promotes three articles instead of four.

GOOGLE HAS NOT RE-READ THE SITEMAP FOR EIGHT DAYS (last read 21 Sep) and the Page indexing build is stale at the same date, so indexed 83 / not indexed 148 is unchanged by construction. 34 of the 117 sitemap HTML pages are still not indexed.

SOCIAL PUBLISHED AGAIN AFTER A THREE-DAY GAP — the Project 251 teak door post ran on both Meta channels on 28 Sep and Instagram's post count moved 131 → 132. Facebook views rose 4,483 → 4,496 while LinkedIn fell back on every line. Followers are unchanged on all four channels for a tenth scan: 271 in total.
